Definition (EN): the feeling of eagerly expecting something
Quote from Episode: Grow tumescent with anticipation.
台词翻译: 带着期待肿胀起来。
Example Sentence: The deal closed a month earlier than anyone had anticipated.
例句翻译: 交易比所有人预期的早一个月敲定。
Usage Note: 形容词 anticipated。动词 anticipate。

Definition (EN): generally believed to be, though not proven
Quote from Episode: Reputed to have whacked one " Dog" Paulson
台词翻译: 据称砍过一个绰号「狗」的保罗森。
Example Sentence: He is the reputed owner of the chain, though no records confirm it.
例句翻译: 据称他是这家连锁的老板，但没有任何记录能证实。
Usage Note: ≈ alleged（法律新闻用 alleged）。名词 reputation 声誉。

Definition (EN): a subordinate who carries out a boss's orders
Quote from Episode: This is one of Tuco's henchmen.
台词翻译: 这是 Tuco 的一个马仔。
Example Sentence: Every racket boss needs a henchman to watch the door.
例句翻译: 每个江湖大佬都得有个马仔看门。
Usage Note: 近义 goon、muscle。带贬义。

Definition (EN): an organized group controlling a trade, often illegally
释义（中文）: 卡特尔（垄断集团）；贩毒集团
Quote from Episode: El Paso says he's got some kind of cartel connection.
台词翻译: 埃尔帕斯奥说他们跟某个卡特尔有关系。
Example Sentence: Prosecutors described the firm as a cartel that fixed prices.
例句翻译: 检方把这家公司描述成操纵价格的卡特尔。
Usage Note: 经济学正式义＝卡特尔；新闻义常指贩毒集团。

Definition (EN): property offered as security for a debt
Quote from Episode: There's always a lot of collateral.
台词翻译: 抵押品总是很多。
Example Sentence: The bank wants collateral before it releases the funds.
例句翻译: 银行要求先有抵押才放款。
Usage Note: ≈ security。动词 collateralize。

Definition (EN): a group of people working together
Quote from Episode: Picked up my whole crew, top to bottom.
台词翻译: 把我整伙人从上到下全端了。
Example Sentence: She assembled a small crew to run the pilot.
例句翻译: 她组了一个小班子来运营这个试点。
Usage Note: 职场中性；犯罪语境＝一伙。a film crew＝摄制组。

Definition (EN): visibly upset and restless
Quote from Episode: When he came home last night, he was agitated, upset.
台词翻译: 他昨晚回到家时情绪很激动，很不安。
Example Sentence: The caller became agitated and hung up.
例句翻译: 对方情绪激动起来，就把电话挂了。
Usage Note: 动词 agitate。名词 agitation。

Definition (EN): socially quiet and uninvolved
Quote from Episode: He's been withdrawn lately.
台词翻译: 他最近越来越封闭自己。
Example Sentence: He grew withdrawn after the move.
例句翻译: 搬走以后他变得很孤僻。
Usage Note: ＝ introverted。动词 withdraw＝退出／取款。

Definition (EN): the way two things affect each other
Quote from Episode: there's no drug interactions
台词翻译: 没有药物相互作用。
Example Sentence: Check for interactions before you combine two prescriptions.
例句翻译: 合并两种处方药前先查相互作用。
Usage Note: 动词 interact。形容词 interactive ＝ 互动的。

Definition (EN): a building where dead bodies are kept
Quote from Episode: Every morgue.
台词翻译: 每一家太平间。
Example Sentence: They checked every morgue within fifty miles.
例句翻译: 他们查了五十英里内每一家太平间。
Usage Note: 读 /ˈmɔːrɡ/，结尾 -gue 不发音。

Definition (EN): a name used instead of one's real name
Quote from Episode: Heisenberg is kind of a pseudonym.
台词翻译: Heisenberg 算是个化名。
Example Sentence: She published her first book under a pseudonym.
例句翻译: 她的第一本书是用化名出版的。
Usage Note: 形容词 pseudonymous。反义 real name。近义 alias。

Definition (EN): police surveillance aircraft
Quote from Episode: They got ghetto birds and black ops.
台词翻译: 他们出动了警用直升机和特勤。
Example Sentence: Two ghetto birds circled the property for an hour.
例句翻译: 两架警用直升机绕着房产转了一个小时。
Usage Note: 俚语。ghetto 在此指警区，非贫民区义。

Definition (EN): to forcibly move from a place or way of life
释义（中文）: 连根拔起；彻底改变生活
Quote from Episode: I can't just uproot my life like that.
台词翻译: 我不能就这样把生活连根拔起。
Example Sentence: The merger uprooted him from a team he'd been on for a decade.
例句翻译: 那次合并把他从待了十年的团队里连根拔走了。
Usage Note: 名词 uprooting。反义 put down roots（扎根）。

Definition (EN): to steal
Quote from Episode: First you boost it, then you leave it in your house.
台词翻译: 你先把它偷了，然后就把它撂在你家里。
Example Sentence: Someone boosted the delivery van overnight.
例句翻译: 有人一夜之间把送货车偷了。
Usage Note: 俚语。也作 give someone a boost＝推一把。

Definition (EN): a condition that destroys thinking and memory
Quote from Episode: There clearly some dementia.
台词翻译: 他明显有痴呆。
Example Sentence: Early dementia is often mistaken for ordinary forgetfulness.
例句翻译: 早期痴呆常被当成普通的忘事。
Usage Note: 形容词 demented ＝ 疯的（俚语）。

Definition (EN): thinking clearly and coherently
释义（中文）: 神志清楚的；表达清晰的
Quote from Episode: He's not lucid.
台词翻译: 他已经不清醒了。
Example Sentence: He had lucid moments but drifted in and out.
例句翻译: 他有时清醒，有时又迷糊过去。
Usage Note: ≈ clear-headed。lucid dreaming＝清明梦。

Definition (EN): a Spanish or Portuguese soap opera
Quote from Episode: he was watching one of those telenovels
台词翻译: 他在看那种拉美肥皂剧。
Example Sentence: Her mother watches a telenovela every afternoon.
例句翻译: 她妈妈每天下午都看一部拉美剧。
Usage Note: 西语直接影响词。≈ soap opera。

Definition (EN): honest and direct in expression
Quote from Episode: you don't seem very forthright about this
台词翻译: 你在这件事上看起来不太坦率。
Example Sentence: She gave a forthright answer that nobody wanted to hear.
例句翻译: 她给了一个没人想听的坦率回答。
Usage Note: 近义 candid、frank。反义 evasive——本集正好两个都出现了。

Definition (EN): something judged more important than the rest
Quote from Episode: my life is not the priority here
台词翻译: 我的命在这儿不算最要紧的。
Example Sentence: Once the outage was handled, security became the priority.
例句翻译: 故障处理完之后，安全就变成了第一优先级。
Usage Note: take priority over／give priority to。形容词 top priority。

Definition (EN): wanting more than one has or deserves
Quote from Episode: Oh, you greedy old bastard.
台词翻译: 你这贪心的老混蛋。
Example Sentence: He was greedy enough to ask for a raise and a promotion.
例句翻译: 他贪到既要加薪又要升职。
Usage Note: 名词 greed。greedy for＝贪恋。

Definition (EN): to move something illegally across a border
Quote from Episode: My cousins are driving up here right now to smuggle us back
台词翻译: 我表哥们正开过来，要把我们偷运回去。
Example Sentence: They were charged with smuggling wildlife products.
例句翻译: 他们被控走私野生动物制品。
Usage Note: 名词 smuggler 走私者。smuggle sth across／in。

Definition (EN): to give someone a reason to act
Quote from Episode: He really tried to motivate him.
台词翻译: 他是真心想激励他。
Example Sentence: Clear goals motivate people more than slogans do.
例句翻译: 明确的目标比口号更能激励人。
Usage Note: 名词 motivation ＝ 动机／干劲。近义 spur on。

Definition (EN): to single someone out for criticism
Quote from Episode: Are you mad-dogging them, Tio?
台词翻译: 你在针对他们开火吗，Tio？
Example Sentence: Reporters started mad-dogging the vendor all week.
例句翻译: 记者们整周都在死咬那个供应商。
Usage Note: mad dog 本义「疯狗」。职场近义：lone voice ＝ 孤军奋战。

Definition (EN): currently among the best-known or most successful
Quote from Episode: On the hit parade, 1998.
台词翻译: 1998 年，正当红的时候。
Example Sentence: Regional carriers are finally on the hit parade.
例句翻译: 区域性的运营商终于也上了热门榜。
Usage Note: 原指歌曲排行榜。反义 also-ran ＝ 陪跑的。

Definition (EN): to make the evidence hold up
Quote from Episode: we couldn't make it stick
台词翻译: 但我们没法把这件事坐实。
Example Sentence: Without a confession the case never made it stick.
例句翻译: 没有口供，这案子一直立不住。
Usage Note: 刑侦语境。stick ＝ 站得住，证据／理论都可用。

Definition (EN): to control things very strictly
Quote from Episode: he runs a tight ship
台词翻译: 他管手下极严。
Example Sentence: She runs a tight ship and nothing slips through.
例句翻译: 她管得极严，一点岔子都不会漏。
Usage Note: 职场高频。反义 run things loosely。

Definition (EN): real and genuine
Quote from Episode: actual, honest-to-God evidence
台词翻译: 实打实的证据。
Example Sentence: That's honest-to-God evidence, not a rumour.
例句翻译: 那是实打实的证据，不是传闻。
Usage Note: 口语强调词。≈ for real。

Definition (EN): hidden in a small enclosed place
Quote from Episode: Found him tucked in the junkyard
台词翻译: 在废品场里找到了他。
Example Sentence: The body was tucked in behind a false wall.
例句翻译: 尸体被塞在一面假墙后面。
Usage Note: ＝ wedged。反义 tucked away（收拾起来）。

Definition (EN): a good thing arrived ahead of schedule
释义（中文）: 圣诞提前到了；好事比预想来得早
Quote from Episode: Christmas came early to the Schrader household.
台词翻译: 施拉德家提前过圣诞了。
Example Sentence: A tax refund is Christmas coming early.
例句翻译: 退税就像是圣诞提前到了。
Usage Note: ≈ Santa came early。职场也指「提前拿到好消息」。

Definition (EN): time off work for your own life
Quote from Episode: I gotta take some personal time.
台词翻译: 我得请几天私事假。
Example Sentence: Employees get five days of personal time a year.
例句翻译: 员工每年有五天事假。
Usage Note: 职场正式说法，≈ PTO。反义 billable time（可计费工时）。

Definition (EN): to interrupt someone's time
Quote from Episode: Really appreciate you sparing us your day off.
台词翻译: 真的感谢你抽出这一整天。
Example Sentence: Thanks for sparing me ten minutes on Friday.
例句翻译: 谢谢你周五抽十分钟给我。
Usage Note: 客气话。正面用：thanks for sparing me the time。

Definition (EN): marks that make someone identifiable
Quote from Episode: What about other distinguishing features?
台词翻译: 其他体貌特征呢？
Example Sentence: The sketch lists three distinguishing features.
例句翻译: 素描上列了三处辨认特征。
Usage Note: 形容词 distinguishing ＝ 有辨识度的。→ distinguish A from B。

Definition (EN): too much to cover
Quote from Episode: I don't know where to begin.
台词翻译: 我都不知道从哪儿说起。
Example Sentence: There's so much to cover in an all-hands.
例句翻译: 全员会上要讲的东西太多了。
Usage Note: 常接 at／on。也作 where to start。

Definition (EN): nothing logged showing it happened
Quote from Episode: No record of it.
台词翻译: 没有任何记录。
Example Sentence: There's no record of the call on any carrier.
例句翻译: 任何运营商都没有这次通话的记录。
Usage Note: 职场也常指「查无此人／无记录」。

Definition (EN): to cling to any weak excuse
释义（中文）: 抓救命稻草；病急乱投医
Quote from Episode: we're grasping at straws here.
台词翻译: 我们这是病急乱投医。
Example Sentence: By March they were grasping at straws for a win.
例句翻译: 到了三月他们抓住任何一点机会不放，指望能赢。
Usage Note: ＝ clutching at straws。desperate 义。

Definition (EN): to give the message on to someone else
Quote from Episode: Please pass along our best wishes.
台词翻译: 请代我们转达最好的祝愿。
Example Sentence: She passed the feedback along without editorialising.
例句翻译: 她把反馈原样转达了，没加评论。
Usage Note: ≈ pass on。反义 hold back（扣下不说）。

Definition (EN): to connect them by phone or email
Quote from Episode: if you could put me in touch with your son.
台词翻译: 如果你能帮我联系上你儿子。
Example Sentence: Please put me in touch with whoever owns the account.
例句翻译: 请帮我联系上这个客户的负责人。
Usage Note: 职场高频。＝ connect someone with。

Definition (EN): to change the accepted account of past events
Quote from Episode: We're gonna rewrite history with this.
台词翻译: 我们要用这个改写历史。
Example Sentence: Don't rewrite history — publish the correction.
例句翻译: 别改写历史，发个更正就行。
Usage Note: 职场也指「重新讲一遍当时发生了什么」。

Definition (EN): to clear something out completely
Quote from Episode: Time to clean the menudo out from between your ears.
台词翻译: 该把你耳朵里的牛杂掏干净了。
Example Sentence: They clean out the archive every second year.
例句翻译: 他们每两年把档案清一次。
Usage Note: clean out ＝ 清空／清走。clean up ＝ 收拾干净。

Definition (EN): to do them a real favour
Quote from Episode: do me a solid and check out a '89 Chevy Monte Carlo
台词翻译: 帮我个忙，查一下那辆 89 款雪佛兰。
Example Sentence: Could you do me a solid and cover my shift Friday?
例句翻译: 能帮我个忙，把周五的班替我上吗？
Usage Note: 俚语。a solid ＝ 一个真正的人情。

Definition (EN): to volunteer for a disastrous job
Quote from Episode: all sacrificial, jumping on a grenade, yo.
台词翻译: 像献祭一样往手雷上扑，老兄。
Example Sentence: Whoever jumps on a grenade first will own the migration.
例句翻译: 谁先抢下这颗雷，迁移这块就归他管。
Usage Note: 职场比喻。同类：hot potato、poison pill。

Definition (EN): to die, or to fail as a business
Quote from Episode: I don't want you to go belly up before we get there.
台词翻译: 我可不想你还没到就翻肚皮了。
Example Sentence: Three of our suppliers went belly up last quarter.
例句翻译: 上季度我们有三家供应商倒闭了。
Usage Note: 企业义比死亡义更常见。反过来 belly up ＝ 死了。

Definition (EN): to strike them on the head
Quote from Episode: You crack him over the head with something
台词翻译: 你拿东西朝他脑袋上砸。
Example Sentence: He cracked the wasp nest over his head with a broom.
例句翻译: 他拿扫帚把马蜂窝拍到了自己头上。
Usage Note: ＝ bonk／whack someone。

Definition (EN): something visually attractive to look at
Quote from Episode: dude needs his eye candy.
台词翻译: 老兄需要点养眼的。
Example Sentence: They hired a designer purely as office eye candy.
例句翻译: 他们请了个设计师，纯粹是为了养眼。
Usage Note: 略贬。职场也指「撑门面的人／项目」。

Definition (EN): to be a sign of a good outcome
Quote from Episode: they haven't found him yet bodes well.
台词翻译: 还没找到他，这算是个吉兆。
Example Sentence: Flat forecasts bode well for the hiring plan.
例句翻译: 持平的预测对招聘计划是个吉兆。
Usage Note: bode well／bode ill 反义。

Definition (EN): a baby on the way
Quote from Episode: you got a bun in the oven.
台词翻译: 你这是有喜了。
Example Sentence: They announced a bun in the oven in December.
例句翻译: 他们十二月宣布有喜了。
Usage Note: 婉辞。反义 empty oven ＝ 没有。

Definition (EN): a car modified with hydraulics so it can bounce
Quote from Episode: It's one of those jack-off low riders
台词翻译: 就是那种傻缺的改装低趴车。
Example Sentence: The low riders were bouncing so hard the windows rattled.
例句翻译: 那些低趴车弹得车窗都在响。
Usage Note: 1970 年代美式改装文化，源自墨西哥裔社区。动词 lowride。

Definition (EN): to call or shout
Quote from Episode: Holler if you need me.
台词翻译: 有事喊我。
Example Sentence: Holler if anything looks off before we ship.
例句翻译: 上线前要是看着哪儿不对就喊我。
Usage Note: 口语。近义 yell、shout。holler at someone ＝ 冲某人嚷。

Definition (EN): within an acceptable tolerance
Quote from Episode: That's close enough.
台词翻译: 差不多就行了。
Example Sentence: If the numbers are within two percent, that's close enough.
例句翻译: 数字在两个百分点以内就算差不多够了。
Usage Note: 常在再追问也没用时收口。＝ good enough。

Definition (EN): to raise it and then abandon it
释义（中文）: 丢出来就不管了；半路撂挑子
Quote from Episode: You can't just bring up secret cell phone and then drop it.
台词翻译: 你不能提了备用手机就不管了。
Example Sentence: He raised the concern in the meeting and dropped it.
例句翻译: 他在会上提了这个问题，然后就没下文了。
Usage Note: ＝ leave hanging。反义 follow through（跟到底）。

Definition (EN): to relax; not rush
Quote from Episode: Take it easy, Tio.
台词翻译: 放松点，Tio。
Example Sentence: Take it easy — we have until Friday.
例句翻译: 别急，我们还有到周五。
Usage Note: 既是真的「别紧张」，也常是敷衍安慰。

Definition (EN): a long stretch of difficult work ahead
Quote from Episode: We got a long ride ahead of us.
台词翻译: 我们前头还有很长的路要走。
Example Sentence: With three rounds of review we had a long ride ahead.
例句翻译: 还有三轮评审等着我们，前路不短。
Usage Note: 原指坐长途车。职场描述长周期项目。

Definition (EN): that is the final arrangement
Quote from Episode: That's the deal.
台词翻译: 我先吃。成交。
Example Sentence: Two invoices in full or nothing — that's the deal.
例句翻译: 两张发票全付，不然免谈——就这么定了。
Usage Note: 职场拍板用语。也作 what's the deal（怎么回事）。
